_evidence: Byte 0x868582 is read by 0x4080eb ('movsx ax,byte [0x868582]; xor ax,word [esi+0x90]; js'): its sign against the sign of the word +0x90 picks the clc exit. It is direction/side state (also the sign selector of records_008943a0's walkers), so both signs and zero are drawn. Any byte is valid.
